# ANALYSIS: BASELINE_ENGINE_STAGE1_BACKTEST

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We ran the Stage-1 autoresearch grinder harness on the baseline engine (no changes) to measure edge_capture, out-of-sample Sharpe ratio, and real-fills simulation on the J source-of-truth anchor days (3 winners, 4 losers). The goal is to establish the baseline performance against which future candidates are compared.

## Mechanism

The grinder harness replays the engine logic over the in-sample period (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using cached OPRA fills for realism. It computes:
- OP-16 edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_J_winners) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_J_losers))
- Walk-forward OOS Sharpe ratio (using a 70/30 time split, embargoed)
- Real-fills P&L on each of the 7 J anchor days (via the realistic OPRA simulator)
